context.currency: Toman (prices stored in billions, displayed in millions)

user_types.bulk_buyer: خریدار عمده - has access to wholesale prices

payment_types.check: چکی - deferred payment, usually higher price

price_structure.bulk_price_check: Wholesale price for check payments (higher than cash)

instant_updates.validation: Ensure price is valid and greater than 0

price_calculation_logic.fallback: If price is 0 or invalid, show 'قیمت نامشخص'

ui_enhancements.state: Active button highlighted, inactive button muted

scenario_1_bulk_buyer_price_switch.description: Bulk buyer switches between cash and check prices
expected_results: Price updates instantly without page reload
Smooth fade animation between price changes
Check price is higher than cash price

scenario_2_regular_user_price_switch.description: Regular user switches between cash and check prices
expected_results: Check price is higher than cash price
No bulk buyer price options shown

scenario_3_invalid_price_handling.description: System handles invalid or missing price data

price_validation: All price values must be greater than 0
Check prices must be higher than cash prices for same user type
Bulk prices must be lower than retail prices for same payment type
ui_validation: Price updates must occur within 100ms of user interaction
Animations must be smooth and not cause layout shifts
Payment type buttons must clearly show active state
Price display must maintain consistent formatting
data_validation: All required data attributes must be present in HTML
Price data must be properly formatted as numbers
User type data must be boolean (true/false)
Product ID must be unique and valid

javascript_errors: Missing data attributes - fallback to default prices
Network errors - maintain current price display
DOM manipulation errors - log error and continue
data_errors: Missing price data - use fallback pricing
Invalid user type - default to regular user pricing
Corrupted price values - validate and sanitize

frontend_optimization: Use CSS transitions instead of JavaScript animations where possible
Cache price calculations to avoid repeated parsing
Minimize DOM queries by storing element references
backend_optimization: Ensure price data is properly formatted in templates
Use efficient database queries for price retrieval
Validate price data at the database level

keyboard_navigation: Price type buttons must be accessible via keyboard
Tab order must be logical and intuitive
Focus indicators must be clearly visible
screen_reader_support: Price changes must be announced to screen readers
Payment type selection must be clearly described
visual_accessibility: Price text must have sufficient contrast
Animation must not cause motion sickness
Color coding must not be the only indicator

fallbacks: CSS transitions fallback to JavaScript animations
